annotations.title: Analyse a transcript file from the terminal

description:
Returns a curl command that uploads a local transcript file (.docx, .txt, .md or .vtt) to FounderBrain for
        analysis, for clients that run commands on the user's own computer, such as Claude Code and Codex.

        path: the full local path of a temporary plain-text copy prepared by the client, containing only speaker turns
        with restricted information removed before upload. The tool does not inspect or clean the file.
        speaker, name and role: the speaker label to analyse, the person's display name when the
        label is generic, and "answering" or "asking". Without a speaker the command only lists the speakers and their
        word counts.
name: open_in_terminal
title: Analyse a transcript file from the terminal
